subject: Retail offer copy + field playbook — AWS onboarding checklist
messages:
From: Alice Zhang <alice.zhang@fastretail.com>
To: rafael_mendes@redwoodinference.com
Cc: kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: AWS listing help — product copy + co-sell assets

Hi Rafael,

Thanks again for walking us through the Seller Registration last week. We're kicking off content for our listing and want a quick sanity check from Redwood before we go live. Top priorities: clear hero messaging (we need to explain inference performance and cost delta), procurement-ready pricing footnotes, and a short field playbook that the sales team at FastRetail can use during buyer conversations.

I've attached our first draft of the MAL (fastretail_MAL_v2.pdf) and a zip of hero images. Can someone on your side review the product bullets and give straightforward edits we can implement this week? Also the AWS rep told us to include a one-paragraph evidence statement about SOC 2 and data isolation — we referenced Redwood's Dedicated offering but want the exact phrasing you prefer.

Target: public listing by Oct 14. Any chance you can loop in the co-sell playbook recommendations and a 1-pager for our field?

Thanks,
Alice
Alice Zhang
Head of Partnerships, FastRetail Inc.

From: rafael_mendes@redwoodinference.com
To: Alice Zhang <alice.zhang@fastretail.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS listing help — product copy + co-sell assets

Hi Alice — thanks for the materials and the clear deadline. We've reviewed the MAL and hero images and put together a lightweight edit pass plus a short field playbook draft. Key changes we recommend (high-level):

- Hero one-liner: move from technical metrics to buyer benefit + proof. Suggest: "Deploy enterprise-grade LLM features with sub-200ms inference and predictable unit cost — backed by SLA-ready dedicated capacity."
- Bullets: reorder to lead with operational guarantees (SLA, private deployment options), then highlight latency/cost numbers, then plug Redwood Optimize (batching/quantization) as mitigations.
- Evidence sentence (SOC2 / data isolation): we recommend: "Redwood offers SOC 2 Type II evidence and optional dedicated VPC deployments with customer-controlled KMS for data separation and audit logging." Please confirm if you want 'SOC 2 Type II' or just 'SOC 2'.
- Pricing footnote: include a short line about meterable units (tokens) and private offer eligibility — see suggested language in the attached PDF.

I've attached a markup PDF with inline copy edits and a short two-page field playbook (one-pager + objection-handling bullets). Also looping in Kimberly for copy polish and Marissa for co-sell enablement (field scripts and outcome metrics).

Next steps: Kimberly to give final voice edits; Marissa to confirm co-sell collateral and a HubSpot win condition we can use for reporting. If all looks good we'll prepare the AWS Private Offer paperwork and a DocuSign for the reseller agreement.

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
--- attachment: rafael_fastretail_edit_pass.pdf (application/pdf)

From: kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com
To: rafael_mendes@redwoodinference.com, Alice Zhang <alice.zhang@fastretail.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 06 Oct 2026 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS listing help — product copy + co-sell assets

Thanks Rafael — quick copy notes below (inline summary, keeping it short for the MAL UX):

- Hero one-liner tweak (short): "Enterprise LLM inference — predictable cost, sub-200ms responses, enterprise-grade controls." (shorter, no hyphen chains).
- Bullets (3): 1) Predictable throughput & SLA-backed Dedicated capacity; 2) Fast inference (sub-200ms typical for 512-token requests on standard SKUs); 3) Cost controls: batching, KV caching, and quantization profiles.
- Evidence: Use exact phrase: "SOC 2 Type II" — customers ask for the specific type. Follow with: "Optional VPC and customer-managed KMS for data isolation."
- Avoid product jargon on the listing (e.g., 'KV cache' -> 'session caching'). Reserve technical detail for a linked technical FAQ doc.

Field playbook suggestions (for FastRetail sellers):
- Elevator: "Redwood Inference helps dev teams ship LLM features faster with predictable latency and lower per-token cost — good fit for customer pilots and productionizing inference."
- 3 objections + responses: pricing, security, integration. (I left short bullets in the attached playbook.)

Rafael/Marissa — I smoothed the wording in the attached PDF. Alice — if you want, I can shorten the one-liner further for mobile hero truncation.

Kimberly Park
Director, Marketplace & GTM Content
Redwood Inference

Hi Alice — quick operational next steps from the Redwood sales enablement side so we can hit your Oct 14 target: 

1) Finalize MAL copy by EOD Fri Oct 9 (Rafael/Kimberly to confirm).
2) I'll produce a one-page co-sell sheet with measurable outcomes (latency, cost delta, pilot success criteria) and a short playbook for FastRetail's sellers — expect first draft by Mon Oct 12.
3) Procurement: we'll prepare an AWS Private Offer template + DocuSign for your legal team; Rafael to confirm final billing wording.
4) Marketplace ops: I'll open a ticket with AWS Seller Support for the SKU + entitlement mapping and attach the evidence statement (SOC 2 Type II + VPC KMS line).

Alice — could you confirm the person on your side who will sign the Private Offer and the internal procurement contact (name + email)? Also, is the marketing team ok with the hero image crop in hero_images_v3.zip? If not, send notes and we'll iterate.

Linking our tracker: https://hubspot.example.com/deal/FR-2026-0432 — I'll log the playbook assets there and tag the FastRetail contacts.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
GTM Partnerships, Redwood Inference
